full_judgment: 8. In support of his contentions the learned Counsel refers the following decision: In the case of Golam Kader being dead his heirs: Nurun Nahar Begum and others vs. Abdul Khaleque Choukider and others 43 DLR(AD)-107 held: "Code of Civil Procedure Or. 1 r. 10 Addition of party in a suit for specific performance of contract-the appellants' averments in the application for addition of party setting up an independent title to the land disentitle them to be included as parties within the framework for the present suit wherein the real question to be determined is whether the contract for sale between the parties therein was genuine and whether on the basis thereof the plaintiffs are entitled to get a decree.
